package student

import (
	"context"
	"strings"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

type PracticeLearningActionIDGenerator interface{ NewID() string }

type PracticeLearningActions struct {
	Actions repository.PracticeLearningActionRepository
	Clock   LearningJourneyClock
	IDs     PracticeLearningActionIDGenerator
}

// ApplyPracticeLearningActionEvidence closes a previously opened Student
// binding only after its immutable Practice result proves an exact match.
type ApplyPracticeLearningActionEvidence struct {
	Actions repository.PracticeLearningActionEvidenceRepository
	Clock   LearningJourneyClock
}

func (useCase ApplyPracticeLearningActionEvidence) Handle(ctx context.Context, studentID, taskInstanceID, idempotencyKey string, input domain.PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundleV2) (domain.PracticeEvidenceReceiptV2, error) {
	if useCase.Actions == nil || useCase.Clock == nil {
		return domain.PracticeEvidenceReceiptV2{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	normalized, err := domain.NormalizePracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundleV2(studentID, taskInstanceID, idempotencyKey, input)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeEvidenceReceiptV2{}, err
	}
	_, err = useCase.Actions.ApplyPracticeLearningActionEvidence(ctx, normalized, useCase.Clock.Now().UTC())
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeEvidenceReceiptV2{}, err
	}
	return domain.PracticeEvidenceReceiptV2{Schema: domain.PracticeEvidenceReceiptSchemaV2, EvidenceID: normalized.EvidenceID,
		LearningActionID: normalized.LearningActionID, Accepted: true, PolicyVersion: domain.MasteryPolicyVersion}, nil
}

func (useCase PracticeLearningActions) Reserve(ctx context.Context, input domain.PracticeLearningActionReserve) (domain.PracticeLearningActionBinding, error) {
	if useCase.Actions == nil || useCase.Clock == nil || useCase.IDs == nil {
		return domain.PracticeLearningActionBinding{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if input.LearningActionID == "" {
		input.LearningActionID = useCase.IDs.NewID()
	} else {
		input.LearningActionIDExplicit = true
	}
	input.OccurredAt = useCase.Clock.Now().UTC()
	normalized, err := domain.NormalizePracticeLearningActionReserve(input)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeLearningActionBinding{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	result, _, err := useCase.Actions.ReservePracticeLearningAction(ctx, normalized)
	return result, err
}

func (useCase PracticeLearningActions) Get(ctx context.Context, studentID, taskInstanceID string) (domain.PracticeLearningActionBinding, error) {
	if useCase.Actions == nil || !domain.IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(strings.TrimSpace(studentID)) || !domain.IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(strings.TrimSpace(taskInstanceID)) {
		return domain.PracticeLearningActionBinding{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return useCase.Actions.GetPracticeLearningAction(ctx, strings.TrimSpace(studentID), strings.TrimSpace(taskInstanceID))
}

func (useCase PracticeLearningActions) Open(ctx context.Context, studentID, taskInstanceID, learningActionID string) (domain.PracticeLearningActionBinding, error) {
	return useCase.transition(ctx, studentID, taskInstanceID, learningActionID, true, "")
}

func (useCase PracticeLearningActions) Cancel(ctx context.Context, studentID, taskInstanceID, learningActionID, reason string) (domain.PracticeLearningActionBinding, error) {
	return useCase.transition(ctx, studentID, taskInstanceID, learningActionID, false, reason)
}

func (useCase PracticeLearningActions) transition(ctx context.Context, studentID, taskInstanceID, learningActionID string, open bool, cancelReason string) (domain.PracticeLearningActionBinding, error) {
	studentID, taskInstanceID, learningActionID = strings.TrimSpace(studentID), strings.TrimSpace(taskInstanceID), strings.TrimSpace(learningActionID)
	if useCase.Actions == nil || useCase.Clock == nil || !domain.IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(strings.TrimSpace(studentID)) ||
		!domain.IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(strings.TrimSpace(taskInstanceID)) || !domain.IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(strings.TrimSpace(learningActionID)) {
		return domain.PracticeLearningActionBinding{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if !open && !domain.IsPracticeLearningActionCancelReason(cancelReason) {
		return domain.PracticeLearningActionBinding{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	now := useCase.Clock.Now().UTC()
	if open {
		result, _, err := useCase.Actions.OpenPracticeLearningAction(ctx, studentID, taskInstanceID, learningActionID, now)
		return result, err
	}
	result, _, err := useCase.Actions.CancelPracticeLearningAction(ctx, studentID, taskInstanceID, learningActionID, cancelReason, now)
	return result, err
}
